thePrive.name: The Privé

overview.content: The Privé is a luxury apartment project in An Phu Ward, Thu Duc City, developed with the orientation toward a luxurious, private, and secluded living space. The project features the slogan "Defining luxury living".

developer.content: The Privé is developed by Dat Xanh Group (Bluemarq Group).

location.content: The Privé is located on the frontage of Song Hanh Street, An Phu Ward, Thu Duc City. The project features 3 riverfront sides and is situated near the An Phu Intersection.

connectivity.content: The Privé offers convenient connectivity to key areas. From the project, it takes about 5 minutes to Thu Thiem, about 10–15 minutes to Thao Dien, and about 20–30 minutes to Binh Thanh. The project is situated near the Ho Chi Minh City – Long Thanh – Dau Giay Expressway, while also benefiting from the master plan for the metro line connecting Long Thanh Airport with Thu Thiem Station.

scale.content: The Privé has a total land area of 6.7 hectares, comprising 12 towers that are 33–35 stories high with a total of 3,175 units. The building density is approximately 25%. The total 6.7-hectare area includes external green parks, surrounding perimeter roads, and riverbank embankments. The project is oriented toward modern architecture, long-term and sustainable development, with a system of over 99 amenities.

products.content: The Privé offers a variety of product types including Garden Units, Typical Units, Garden Duplexes, Sky Duplexes, and Penthouses. Standard apartments include 1-bedroom, 2-bedroom, and 3-bedroom units with various floor areas depending on the unit type and specific tower.

delivery_standard.content: The Privé's apartment handover standard covers the following areas: The Living Room & Dining Room are paved with 800x800mm volcanic stone-grain tiles; the main door is fire-rated solid wood with an aluminum alloy core, integrated with a 4-mode smart lock and one-way video call doorbell. The Kitchen features upper and lower cabinets finished with anti-fingerprint dragon scale veneer, an artificial stone countertop, walls clad in Sintered Stone, and kitchen appliances by Brandt or Bosch. Bedrooms are fitted with premium wooden flooring, double-glazed Low-E windows, and concealed ceiling-mounted air conditioning. Bathrooms/WC are clad with 45x90cm porcelain tiles and equipped with Duravit sanitary ware including wall-hung toilets and tempered glass partitions. The Logia & drying area are paved with anti-slip wood-grain tiles and pre-fitted with hot water piping/equipment.

compound.content: The Privé is designed according to a compound model with multiple layers of security control. At the 1st-floor internal landscape, the system of doors, gates, and fences combined with landscaped greenery and railings helps restrict external visitors from entering the premises. The basement features a vehicle access control gate system and a car-parking system. The main lobbies of each tower utilize an access control security system. The top floor of each tower serves as the technical floor.

area.content: The Privé offers 1-bedroom apartments with built-up areas of 49.80 m² and 54.80 m². The 2-bedroom apartments range from 71.50–88.70 m², including 71.50 m², 76.30 m², 80.60 m², 80.90 m², 81.00 m², and 88.70 m². The 3-bedroom apartments range from 93.70–98.50 m², including 93.70 m² and 98.50 m². Areas may vary depending on the tower, unit type, and layout; built-up area and carpet area (usable area) should be distinguished.

tower.content: The Privé consists of 12 towers with a specific product breakdown: Tower 1 has 267 units comprising 259 Typical Units and 8 Sky Duplexes; Tower 2 has 267 units comprising 259 Typical Units and 8 Sky Duplexes; Tower 3 has 274 units comprising 7 Garden Duplexes, 259 Typical Units, and 8 Sky Duplexes; Tower 4 has 274 units comprising 7 Garden Duplexes, 259 Typical Units, and 8 Sky Duplexes; Tower 5 has 274 units comprising 7 Garden Duplexes, 259 Typical Units, and 8 Sky Duplexes; Tower 6 has 267 units comprising 259 Typical Units and 8 Sky Duplexes; Tower 7 has 274 units comprising 7 Garden Duplexes, 259 Typical Units, and 8 Sky Duplexes; Tower 8 has 258 units comprising 250 Typical Units and 8 Sky Duplexes; Tower 9 has 262 units comprising 4 Garden Duplexes, 250 Typical Units, and 8 Sky Duplexes; Tower 10 has 249 units comprising 241 Typical Units and 8 Sky Duplexes; Tower 11 has 249 units comprising 241 Typical Units and 8 Sky Duplexes; Tower 12 has 260 units comprising 2 Garden Duplexes, 250 Typical Units, and 8 Sky Duplexes.

construction.content: The Privé commenced construction in January 2025. Completion of the foundation and basement for the entire project is expected in Q4/2025, with topping out in Q3/2026. The estimated apartment handover time is 26 months from the date of signing the Sale and Purchase Agreement (SPA).

legal.content: The Privé was granted the construction permit for the entire project in September 2024. For foreign buyers, the contract form is applied in accordance with regulations, including a 50-year lease agreement or a Sale and Purchase Agreement (SPA) depending on eligible cases. Foreigners are permitted to purchase apartments in compliance with State regulations, and contracts are drawn up bilingually. Upon handover, any difference between actual area and the area specified in the SPA is governed specifically within the SPA.

handover.content: The Privé hands over apartments with high-end standards. The clear ceiling height is 2.75m; fire-rated wooden main doors integrated with smart locks from Hafele, Yale, or Adel; double-glazed Low-E aluminum-glass door systems; ceiling-concealed air conditioning. The kitchen features appliances and cabinetry from Brandt (France), with a kitchen island; sanitary ware by Duravit (Germany); Schindler elevators. Living room floors are paved with porcelain tiles, bedrooms feature wooden flooring, and laundry areas utilize wood-grain tiles.

amenities.content: The Privé is developed following a private compound model with internal amenities exclusively for residents. The project features 3 salt-electrolysis swimming pools totaling over 3,000 m², along with facilities such as gym, yoga, sports areas, and dining rooms. The amenity zone is organized in an enclosed compound space, prioritizing privacy and convenience for residents.

price.content: The reference selling price for The Privé is currently around 120 million VND/m², excluding VAT. Actual prices may vary depending on the tower, unit location, unit type, floor area, and sales policies at each specific time.

payment.content:
The Privé offers multiple payment methods. The bank loan payment option consists of 10% initial payment, 60% disbursed by the bank, 25% upon handover, and 5% upon receiving the Ownership Certificate (pink book). For example, with a 1BR unit priced at 7 billion VND: 700 million initial payment, 4.2 billion bank disbursement, 1.75 billion upon handover, and 350 million upon certificate receipt. A 2BR unit at 10.5 billion VND: 1.05 billion – 6.3 billion – 2.625 billion – 525 million. A 2BR unit at 11.5 billion VND: 1.15 billion – 6.9 billion – 2.875 billion – 575 million. A 3BR unit at 14 billion VND: 1.4 billion – 8.4 billion – 3.5 billion – 700 million.

The early payment option offers a 12% discount. After discount, the 1BR unit drops from 7 billion to 6.16 billion VND; the 10.5 billion 2BR unit drops to 9.24 billion VND; the 11.5 billion 2BR unit drops to 10.12 billion VND; the 14 billion 3BR unit drops to 12.32 billion VND. If continuing to apply the 10% – 60% – 25% – 5% schedule on the discounted price, the corresponding amounts are calculated based on the reduced price.

The standard installment payment option offers 2 discount choices of 4% and 6%. Under the 4% discount plan: installment 1 is 10%, installment 2 is 5%, installment 3 is 5%, installments 4–24 are 1% each installment, handover is 54%, and ownership certificate is 5%. Under the 6% discount plan: installment 1 is 10%, installment 2 is 5%, installment 3 is 5%, installments 4–16 are 2% each installment, installments 17–24 are 3% each installment, handover is 25%, and ownership certificate is 5%.

In addition, special payment methods feature milestones of 10%, 5%, 25%, 54%, 60%, and 71% depending on the chosen plan. For instance, with a 7 billion VND unit: 10% is 700 million, 5% is 350 million, 25% is 1.75 billion, 54% is 3.78 billion, 60% is 4.2 billion, and 71% is 4.97 billion VND. The 10.5 billion, 11.5 billion, and 14 billion VND units are calculated proportionally at the same rates.

banking.content: The Privé has 7 partner banks supporting buyers with financing and home mortgages, including MB Bank, VietinBank, OCB, BIDV, MBV, TPBank, and LPBank. Buyers can select a suitable bank based on their needs and borrowing criteria.

rental.content: The Privé currently does not announce any developer rental commitment policy. Investors may manage and lease out their apartments independently once regulatory conditions are met. Rental rates and operational yields depend on the unit type, floor area, location, interior furnishings, and market conditions at each given time.

investment.content: The Privé offers investment potential thanks to its location in South Rach Chiec, convenient connectivity to Thu Thiem, and proximity to major infrastructure projects such as the An Phu Intersection, the Ho Chi Minh City – Long Thanh – Dau Giay Expressway, and Ring Road 3. In the medium and long term, the Ho Chi Minh City – Long Thanh – Dau Giay Expressway is slated for section-by-section expansion, alongside transportation planning connecting Thu Thiem with Long Thanh Airport. In addition, the project is situated near the Rach Chiec National Sports Complex, an area planned for large-scale sports developments proposed by Sun Group, including a 50,000-seat outdoor stadium, a 4,500-seat aquatic sports arena, and an 8,000-seat multi-purpose gymnasium and performance arena. The adjacent area also features The Global City with a commercial center spanning approximately 123.000 m², an outdoor musical fountain canal, and a comprehensive commercial-entertainment amenity ecosystem. These infrastructure, transportation, sports, commercial, and urban factors can generate further growth momentum for local real estate value. However, actual capital appreciation depends on infrastructure progress, supply, market demand, and the timing of investment, and does not constitute a guaranteed return.
